description: Create an opportunity — a validated problem or possibility worth pursuing. Opportunities are the bridge between raw signals and themed roadmap work. Requires `write` scope.

description.description: What the opportunity is and why it matters.

evidence.description: Free-text evidence backing the opportunity (links, quotes, source records). Persisted on the opportunity.

rice.description: RICE prioritisation inputs, required to create. Send all four numbers plus one rationale. Each number snaps to the nearest RICE bucket (the server derives the stored value from it). Placeholder scoring is accepted: reach 10, impact 0.25, confidence 0.2 (Hypothesis), operatorLoad 1.

confidence.description: Confidence in the estimates, 0–1 (1 = fully confident). Values above 1 are clamped to 1.

impact.description: How much it moves the needle (0.25 | 0.5 | 1 | 2 | 3).

operatorLoad.description: Operator review/HIL attention to ship this — the cost axis (NOT engineering effort). Higher = more operator supervision.

rationale.description: Why these scores; backs all four factors. Required.

reach.description: How many users are affected per period.

source.description: Where the opportunity came from. Allowed: client | sales | stakeholder | internal | strategy (default internal).

themeId.description: Theme to assign this opportunity to.

type.description: Opportunity type. Allowed: FEATURE | ENHANCEMENT | TECH_DEBT | KTLO | BUG (default FEATURE).

name: anyforge_create_opportunity
title: Create opportunity
